summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season today against league newcomers Wednesfield in an exciting match that saw the team play well with 5 new players in the starting 11. After taking an early lead through a Bevan header from a Mitch Nolan corner, the Ramblers dominated possession but couldn't add to their score before Wednesfield grabbed a freak equalizer in the 42nd minute. The final score ended 1-1 in what was a positive start for the new-look squad on a dry, bouncy pitch.
